title: Drupal SFTP lockout: a 90-minute recovery and a fail2ban rule
lede: A brute-force run locked the only admin out of a Drupal 8 site at 23:41. Here is the 90-minute recovery and the fail2ban rule that ended it.
hero_alt: Overhead desk: incident log 23:41, fail2ban sheet, manila Drupal folder, brass plate, padlock, red wax seal.
